Fuses or OVER-CURRENT RELEASES omitted due to provision of two MEANS OF PROTECTION between all parts of opposite polarity within MAINS PART, and between all parts of MAINS PART and earth

regulations.name: IEC 60127
regulations.description: Standard for fuses - high breaking capacity (1500 A)

semantic_fragments.content: For clause 8.11.5, fuses complying with IEC 60127 are required to have high breaking capacity of 1500 A and prospective short-circuit current greater than 35 A or 10 times the current rating of the fuse, whichever is greater. Justification for omission of fuses or OVER-CURRENT RELEASES must be documented.

For clause 9.2.1, the device under test has no moving parts, therefore all requirements related to moving parts hazards and TRAPPING ZONEs are marked N/A. RISK CONTROLS for moving parts are not applicable.

Clause 8.11.6 internal wiring requirements: cross-sectional area of internal wiring in MAINS PART between MAINS TERMINAL DEVICE or APPLIANCE INLET and protective devices must not be less than the minimum required for POWER SUPPLY CORD per clause 8.11.3.3. Additionally, sizes of tracks on printed wiring circuits must be sufficient to prevent fire in case of fault currents. When necessary, ME EQUIPMENT connected to SUPPLY MAINS with max available short-circuit fault, and simulation of a fault in single insulation in MAINS PART must not result in any HAZARDOUS SITUATIONS per 13.1.2.
